title: Bound storage retained for process-defaulted work sessions
outcome: Repeated unconfigured shell invocations do not grow session-keyed projection and protocol-attempt storage without bound.
acceptance: A documented reclamation or bounded reuse policy covers work_session_state and work_protocol_attempts created by process-defaulted sessions.
Concurrency, integrity verification, and session isolation remain fail-closed under the selected policy.

completion.summary: Bound process-default session retention with creator-paid indexed reclamation, exact seven-day reuse refusal, complete exclusion/rollback/query-plan coverage, and consistent CLI/MCP/docs behavior.
